title: Design System: hafizhfadh.id — Warm Technical Editorial

display.purpose: Homepage hero headline only — two lines, final word italic terracotta.

headline.purpose: Section H2s and CTA band titles (band at clamp(1.9rem, 3.6vw, 2.9rem)); page-header H1s and the contact invitation scale up to clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 4rem).

title.purpose: Chapter and item titles in Instrument Serif; smaller serif roles at 1.4–1.7rem.

body.purpose: Manrope running text — lead 1.125rem, standard 1.0625rem, compact 0.9375rem, small 0.875rem; 36–62ch measure.

label.purpose: Lowercase IBM Plex Mono micro-labels at 0.75rem — sage-deep on ivory, ivory/60 on navy; breadcrumb trails in ink-muted with the current page in charcoal.

data.purpose: Dates, metrics, stack lists, attributions, breadcrumbs, diagram annotations — mono is a measurement instrument, never a voice.

shadows.name: button-ambient
shadows.purpose: Warm clay-tinted lift under the primary button; hover deepens to rgba(154,62,35,0.6) at 0 12px 32px -14px.

shadows.name: form-panel-float
shadows.purpose: The cream contact form panel floating over the navy invitation section.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal rise and fade (0.7s) — the system's default editorial easing.

motion.name: ease-draw
motion.purpose: Homepage hero schematic stroke draw-in (1.4s) — the site's one authored load animation.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Button, chip, input, and link state transitions.

motion.name: duration-underline
motion.purpose: Nav-link underline growth; wordmark period scale.

motion.name: reveal-rise
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal offset; JS-applied only (content visible without JS), IntersectionObserver threshold 0.12 with −48px bottom margin, one-shot; CTA bands and page sections reveal as whole units.

motion.name: pulse-soft
motion.purpose: The only ambient loop: terracotta diagram pulse dots (opacity 1→0.55, scale 1→1.25).

motion.name: spin-slow
motion.purpose: Hero dashed terracotta ring rotation — three turns, once, then at rest.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion clamp — the reveal action never hides content.

narrative.overview: A personal letter from a senior engineer, set like a fine engineering annual report — warmth carrying authority. The whole site is warm ivory paper: type-led compositions ruled with sand hairlines, deep navy sections anchoring the proof and the invitation, and one family of fired-earth accents that lets the page speak (terracotta) and act (clay). Density is low and confidence is high; every claim is set in a measured serif and every number in a working mono. The system deliberately refuses two references. The first is the old world — a dark obsidian telemetry dashboard with emerald accents — now the anti-reference: no dark grounds outside the navy anchors, no neon, no glow, no classification tags, no dashboard chrome. The second is the generic cream-and-serif consultancy template: this system earns its editorial character through a complete structure — navy anchor sections, sand hairlines instead of cards, sage technical linework, true bylines and pull-quotes, italic-mono figure captions, and terracotta so rare it always means something. The world now spans nine prerendered routes — home, a services index with three service pages, experience, expertise, about, and contact — each a static brochure page composed from one shared kit. Every content page follows the same spine: a cream page-header band (mono breadcrumbs, serif headline, measured lead), sections alternating ivory and cream grounds, and a navy CTA band that closes the page as its single conversion point — always exactly one clay pill. Between sections, exploration stays quiet: underlined arrow text links move readers between pages, never competing pills. The homepage remains the long-form letter — the asymmetric hero with its authored systems schematic, the standing note, service summaries, the navy impact ledger, selected experience, philosophy in brief, the process strip, and the contact invitation — while the full timeline, the complete principles field guide, and the mono toolkit index each hold their own route.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory canvas (#f4efe5) with cream panels (#faf8f2); structure drawn as 1px sand hairlines (#e5d8c4), never boxed cards

Nine prerendered brochure routes sharing one anatomy: cream page-header band (breadcrumbs + serif headline + lead), ivory/cream section alternation, navy CTA conversion band; route-based nav active states in clay
Navy (#172b40) appears only as full-bleed anchors — one conversion band per page (the CTA band, or the contact invitation on /contact), the homepage's impact ledger, and the navy-deep footer
Terracotta (#c85a3a) for display emphasis; clay (#b04a2c) for everything interactive
Editorial serif display (Instrument Serif) with italic terracotta emphasis; Manrope body; IBM Plex Mono strictly for data, dates, and technical annotations
Sage (#687c70) authored SVG line-art with italic mono figure captions ("fig. 01 — …")
One authored motion moment — the homepage hero schematic draws in; scroll reveals are gentle, JS-applied, and reduced-motion safe
Pill buttons; soft 8–16px corners only where content is contained; focus rings in clay (clay-light on navy)

rules.name: The Terracotta Speaks, Clay Acts Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is display-only emphasis — type, nodes, punctuation. Every interactive state is clay or clay-dark. Terracotta is never a surface you can click; clay is never a headline color.

rules.name: The Full-Bleed Navy Rule
rules.body: Deep navy appears only as full-bleed, page-level anchors — never as cards, panels, or sidebars on ivory. Every content page carries exactly one navy conversion anchor (the CTA band; the contact invitation on /contact) plus the navy-deep footer; the homepage adds the impact ledger as its mid-page anchor.

rules.name: The Warm Ink Rule
rules.body: Ink is warm charcoal on warm paper — never pure black, never cool gray. On navy, text is fog or ivory, and muted levels are made with opacity (ivory/60, ivory/15), not by inventing new grays.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif ships one weight — 400 — plus italics. Hierarchy is size, tracking, and italics; never bold the serif and never fake a heavier display weight.

rules.name: The Mono Is a Measurement Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono appears only as data, dates, metrics, stack lists, attributions, lowercase micro-labels, breadcrumbs, and figure captions. Never for headlines, never for running prose, never uppercase.

rules.name: The Two Shadows Rule
rules.body: Only the primary button and the contact form panel cast shadows. Everything else is flat: if a surface needs separating, use a sand hairline or change the ground — never add a shadow.

rules.name: The Hairline Structure Rule
rules.body: If it separates, it's a 1px sand rule. If it contains, it may round (8px fields, 16px panels). If it's pressed, it's a pill. Nothing else gets a border.

dos: Do draw structure with 1px sand hairlines (#e5d8c4) — divide-y chapters, border-t rows, border-y section frames — instead of reaching for a card.

Do give every content page the same spine — Seo meta with canonical + og.png, cream PageHeader, ivory/cream alternation, navy CtaBand close — and let only the homepage break it with its hero and ledger.
Do route navigation through src/lib/data/navigation.ts so navbar, mobile menu, and footer share one source, with aria-current="page" marking the active route.
Do keep IBM Plex Mono strictly for data: dates, metrics, "·"-joined stack lists, attributions, lowercase micro-labels, breadcrumbs, and figure captions.
Do set emphasis in serif italic, and spend terracotta (#c85a3a) only where the page speaks loudest — the hero's final word, the wordmark's period, diagram pulse nodes.
Do make every interactive element clay (#b04a2c) with a 2px clay focus ring (clay-light #e09b77 on navy) — pills for conversion, underlined arrow links for exploration.
Do author diagrams as sage line art (1–1.5px strokes, round caps) with italic mono captions ("fig. NN — …").

Do hold body copy to a 36–62ch measure, let whitespace — 64/80px on sub-pages, 80/112px on home — do the separating, and respect reduced motion: reveals never hide content, animations clamp to ~0ms, and pages must be fully readable with JavaScript off.
donts: Don't box content: no card grids, no repetitive card rows, no nested cards — compose with hairline-ruled rows and asymmetric 12-col splits.
Don't resurrect the old dark dashboard: no obsidian grounds, emerald telemetry accents, neon glows, gradient text, or SERVICE // 01-style classification tags.
Don't set headlines or prose in mono, and never uppercase the mono labels — they stay lowercase.
Don't add eyebrow kickers above headlines.

Don't use navy as a component fill (the selected radio chip is the one exception) or shrink it into boxes and sidebars — navy is full-bleed only: one conversion anchor per page, the homepage ledger, and the footer.
Don't spend clay pills on wayfinding — moving between pages is an exploration arrow link; the pill is for the conversation.
Don't ship a route without its Seo block — every page must resolve to one canonical URL at https://hafizhfadh.id with the shared og.png.

Don't introduce a second authored load animation; the hero draw-in is the homepage's one motion moment (diagram pulse dots are the only loop). Never bold Instrument Serif or fake a heavier display weight.
